card.name: Thresholds and cutoffs in lab criteria
card.fires_on: Comparison or linking words such as "or", "≥", "<", ">" and "to" that come right after a number or measure and before a second threshold value. Seen in dose tables, lab-value cutoffs and adverse-event criteria.

modes.label: Or after a threshold
modes.description: The word "or" joins two cutoff values or conditions.
modes.example: The proportion of patients with a decline in LVEF from baseline of ≥ 20%<< or>> a decline from baseline of 10

modes.label: Comparison symbols
modes.description: The symbols ≥, < or > sit just before a numeric cutoff.

modes.label: Wording of a limit
modes.description: A word within a phrase such as "greater than or equal to" or "10% or less".
modes.example: FR] greater than or equal<< to>> 45 mL/min/1.
